name: CastingSubmissionsBoard
tagline: Run casting end to end – breakdowns, submissions, self-tapes, callbacks, offers and bookings in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete casting app for Canvas apps, Model-driven apps and Power Pages: a drag-and-drop pipeline board with casting rules (audition and callback dates, availability, budgets, bookings per role, double bookings, minors), role breakdowns with shortlist comparison, a submissions list with bulk actions, a weekly audition schedule, an offer dialog with checklist and a dashboard.
features: Pipeline board with drag & drop and keyboard moves
Casting rules: dates, availability, budget, bookings per role, double booking, minors
Offer dialog with checklist and OfferRequestJson
Bulk status and release with undo
Weekly audition, callback and self-tape schedule
Phone layout with status chips and bottom navigation
